hooks.name: kiro-usage-log
hooks.description: Keep a running, dated log of how Kiro was used, so the Kiroween write-up is evidence rather than recollection.

action.prompt: If this turn changed any files, append one dated line to docs/kiro-usage-log.md in the form '- YYYY-MM-DD — <what changed> — <Kiro features used: spec / task / steering / hook / MCP / PBT / power / custom agent (only if a custom agent was actually used)>'. Be factual and brief. If nothing changed, do nothing.
